messages.subject: secr 2.9.1
parts:
A new release of secr is starting to find its way to CRAN mirror sites. Check out the NEWS for a list of changes. The main feature is flexible machinery for detection models based on non-Euclidean distances, documented in the new vignette secr-noneuclidean.pdf. A few bugs are fixed. The 'start' argument of secr.fit() can now be a named list of one or more 'real' parameter values, and there are other labour-saving tweaks.
Murray
